title: Brahmacariyaṃ
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || || 3. Brahmacariyañ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi || brahmacariyaphalāni ca || taṃ suṇātha || || 4. Katamañ ca bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ || ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || pa || sammāsamādhi || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ || || 5. Katamāni ca bhikkhave brahmacariyaphalāni || || Sotāpattiphalaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ anāgāmiphalam arahattaphalaṃ || || Imāni vuccanti bhikkhave brahmacariyaphalānīti || ||
